title: GRO-Seq
scope: Core 2008 GRO-seq (Core, Waterfall and Lis) at the architecture level shown by the assigned Illumina schematic: nuclear Br-UTP run-on, RNA isolation/hydrolysis, antibody-bead enrichment, captioned elution/cap-removal/end-repair block, and reverse transcription/amplification to a physical cDNA library. BRIC-Seq, Bru-Seq, BruChase-Seq and the adjacent RAP row are separate implementations outside this assigned target; the grouping does not establish aliases or interchangeable complete protocols.

operations.label: Extend nascent RNA in a Br-UTP nuclear run-on
operations.description: Already engaged polymerases extend their associated nascent RNA in nuclei, incorporating BrU from the supplied Br-UTP analog.
operations.mechanism: Polymerase-catalysed RNA extension incorporates the ribonucleotide analog. The scoped 2008 paper reports run-on conditions under which new initiation is prohibited.
operations.information_effect: BrU marks RNA extended in the run-on, tying the selected material to transcriptionally engaged polymerases at the assay boundary.

operations.label: Isolate and hydrolyze run-on RNA
operations.description: Isolate RNA from the run-on preparation and chemically fragment it, retaining the depicted mixture of star-bearing and unstarred fragments.
operations.mechanism: The source caption groups isolation and hydrolysis; the primary paper identifies chemical hydrolysis of NRO-RNA to short fragments.
operations.information_effect: Fragmentation shortens the RNA carrier and supports localization near polymerase origin. It does not itself select BrU-containing fragments.

operations.label: Capture BrU-containing RNA on antibody-coated beads
operations.description: Enrich the BrU-bearing RNA fragments from the fragmented preparation by retention on the depicted antibody-coated beads.
operations.mechanism: Antibody recognition of the incorporated BrU analog retains labelled RNA on the bead support. The core paper reports repeated immunopurification; the drawing represents capture as one block rather than separate rounds.
operations.information_effect: Selection is for BrU-containing run-on RNA, yielding an enriched preparation. Enrichment is not perfect biological specificity and the label does not itself assign a polymerase class.

evidence.locator: b00006, interpretation of BrU-based selection
evidence.quote: BrU-containing NRO-RNA was triple-selected through immunopurification with an antibody that is specific for this nucleotide analog, resulting in a 10,000-fold enrichment of the NRO-RNA pool that was determined to be >98% pure (8).
evidence.rationale: Recognition of an incorporated nucleotide analog establishes the chemical basis of enrichment. It does not by itself establish exclusive RNA-polymerase-class specificity; the reported greater-than-98-percent purity also describes enrichment rather than an absolute exclusion of background.
